newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Evea Pank to issue shares, boost capital.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Evea Pank to issue shares, boost capital.

text.p: Estonian bank Evea Pank, the 10th largest bank which is quoted on the stock exchange, said on Monday that it planned to boost its share capital to 100 million kroons from 71 million kroons.
The bank said in a statement that the capital boost would be carried out via a share issue and by reinvesting 1997 profits.
The new share issue will be from 0.5-1.0 million new shares, it added.
The bank's management will propose the increase in capital to the board and at a general meeting which has to approve the details.
